provenance.method: author-declared design tokens mined from omp.sh stylesheet (index-Cxvog3cH.css) plus the two meta theme-color declarations; brand_extract returned insufficient_signal on the SPA shell, so tokens were read directly from the stylesheet custom properties.
provenance.canvas: meta theme-color light #f5f0ea; corroborated by --bg oklch(94% .006 80)
provenance.accent: --accent oklch(44% .18 348) = --color-magenta family -> #920864 (deep, text-scale); bright fill --color-magenta oklch(70% .24 340) -> #f84fcc
provenance.fonts: --font-display Fraunces (bundled), --font-mono JetBrains Mono (bundled), --font-sans Geist approximated by bundled Inter

readability.accent_note: deep magenta #920864 (contrast 7.6 on paper) is the text-scale accent; bright magenta #f84fcc is graphic-only (dots, glows, active markers).

per_scene_light.1_title: large near-black Fraunces headline on paper (dark hero coverage)
per_scene_light.2_sc_rename: solid dark editor window + big display code lines (dark coverage)
per_scene_light.3_mono_hashline: near-black mono lines, deep-magenta accent line
per_scene_light.4_split_debug: polarity contrast, magenta value on the omp side
per_scene_light.5_sc_loopback: money shot, dark editor window, magenta first line, scale punch

readability.brightness_plan: light canvas passes the frame-brightness gate by construction; the two screen_capture editor windows and the split provide the dark value beats.
readability.inverted_beat: the split scene flips polarity between its two panes
